text.p: Anglo-Swedish steel company Avesta Sheffield was expected on Thursday to post a sharply lower pre-tax profit of 163 million crowns for the first nine months of 1996/97, a Reuters poll found.
This compared to a pre-tax profit of 3.15 billion crowns in the same period a year earlier.
Forecasts from nine analysts for pre-tax profit for the nine months to December 31, 1996, varied between zero and 256 million crowns.
Avesta was forecast to report a pre-tax profit of 506 million crowns for full year 1996/97. Forecasts varied between 100 and 715 million crowns.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Carnegie, Enskilda, Foreningsbanken, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Morgan Grenfell, Nordiska, Swedbank, and Ohman.
Avesta Sheffield will release its nine-month report on Thursday, February 13.
